name: Les Halles
type: destroyed building or structure; food market
text: Les Halles (French pronunciation: [le al]; 'The Halls') was Paris's central fresh food market. It last operated on 12 January 1973 and was replaced by an underground shopping centre and a park. The unpopular modernist development was demolished in 2010 and replaced by the Westfield Forum des Halles, a modern shopping mall built largely underground and topped by an undulating 2.5 hectare canopy.

depictions.name: Les Halles
depictions.text: Les Halles (English: The Halls) was the central market for all of Paris' fresh food. It was demolished in 1971 and replaced by the Westfield Forum des Halles, a modern shopping mall.
